candidates: When reviewing new or modified regular expressions in `packages/mermaid/src/diagram-api/regexes.ts`, or any regex applied to user-provided diagram text, audit for ReDoS (Regular Expression Denial of Service) vulnerabilities. Patterns with nested quantifiers, overlapping alternations, or unbounded repetitions (e.g. `\s*` inside a larger quantified group) can exhibit polynomial or exponential backtracking on adversarial inputs. Verify the regex cannot catastrophically backtrack, and consider using atomic groups, possessive quantifiers, or a linear-time alternative; flag any new pattern that a static-analysis tool (such as GitHub Advanced Security's regex scanner) would classify as polynomial on uncontrolled input.
